MethodtestProjectReloadAfterMethodFilterMigration
Test caseEPBDS-16275
Known issue—
DescriptionA project whose module declares a method filter of its own reloads once and settles: the loading overlay must reach a quiet window and the table must stay. Guards the reload loop of EPBDS-16275, which the JSF shell fell into after its ViewState was evicted; the filter is written into the descriptor, which is where a module's own filter is declared and where the card reads it from; the card then lifts it to the project, which is the migration this scenario reloads after.
